title: MrBeast
subtitle: The Unauthorized Biography
author: Walusimbi Leon (SGSS)
description: The unauthorized biography of Jimmy Donaldson — MrBeast — the story of how a shy kid from North Carolina became YouTube's biggest creator.
style: Energetic, engaging, journalistic prose. Factual, with vivid storytelling.
characters: Jimmy Donaldson (MrBeast), his family, and his crew.
setting: Greenville, North Carolina, and the internet.
notes: Continue the biography in order: his early videos, the obsession with virality, the giveaways, the empire (Beast Philanthropy, Feastables), and the controversies. Keep it factual and compelling.
